source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    motif = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(zr1-zr0+1):
        for dc in range(zc1-zc0+1):
            out[zr0+dr][zc0+dc] = motif[dr][len(motif[0])-1-dc]
    return out
'''
